verses.saheeh: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We have assuredly given you, O Muhammad (s), Abundance — [the name of] a river in Paradise and his [the Prophet’s] pool around which his community shall gather; al-kawthar also means the abundant good [that has been given to the Prophet], such as prophethood, the Qur'an, intercession, and the like.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Nabi ) Hum ne tumhein kausar ata kar diya

verses.saheeh: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
verses.khattab: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So pray to your Lord, the prayer of the Festival of Immolation (‘īd al-nahr), and sacrifice, your offering.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas tum apne Rubb hi ke liye namaz padho aur qurbani karo

verses.saheeh: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
verses.khattab: Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed it is your antagonist, your hater, who is the severed one, refraining from all [acts of] good, or the one whose line of offspring will be severed [by his not having any]: this was revealed regarding al-‘Āsī b. Wā’il, who called the Prophet (s) al-abtar, ‘the severed one’, when his son al-Qāsim died.
